text:
Ari (AE): Hey team — quick heads up, CobaltBank procurement escalated during legal review. They want confirmation on VPC peering + firewall IP allowlist + throughput guarantees before exec signoff. They also asked if we can support a private KMS in their VPC. Need engineering + security input, and an exec bridge if we can't resolve by EOD.
Derek (Eng): Can you paste the exact firewall/IP ask? is this per-region or global?
Ari (AE): They sent: "require egress to 3 IPs, 100Mbps sustained per endpoint, TLS mutual auth preferred". Region: eu-west-1 only for now.
Maya (Eng-Infra): 100Mbps sustained is within Dedicated capacity but depends on batch sizing and protocol (websocket vs http2). If they're on Hosted we can route via a dedicated egress pool but that needs SRE config.
Priya (Security): For private KMS we need to confirm keywrap + attestation; we support BYO-KMS for Private deployment and Dedicated with peering, but Hosted with customer-managed keys is limited. Sending questionnaire section they need to fill.
Liam (SalesOps): FYI pricing team flagged a delta for Dedicated egress config. I can run a quick ballpark.
Ari (AE): They want to avoid Dedicated if possible due to procurement timelines. Can eng suggest short-term workaround (allowlist + peering) that keeps them on Hosted?
Derek (Eng): Short term: we can set up IP allowlist + TLS client certs and a routing rule to eu-west-1 with pinned nodes. That keeps them on Hosted but with higher SLO risk; fallback to Dedicated if throughput or isolation becomes an issue. Need network CIDR list from CobaltBank.
Priya (Security): We also need SOC2 evidence and encrypted-at-rest details. I'll attach the SOC2 excerpt and the KMS FAQ.
Nora (Legal): Procurement wants a clause for data residence and audit access in SOW. We can add standard language but need to confirm retention windows and logging scope.
Ari (AE): Scheduling: CISO + procurement bridge tomorrow 10:00am Europe. Can we get a short tech note by EOD that I can share?
Maya (Eng-Infra): I'll draft a one-page runbook: network flow, cert setup, fallback plan, and expected latency/throughput numbers.
Derek (Eng): Also adding a quick curl example for their infra team to test egress acceptance.
exec-ops-bot: Reminder: "exec-bridge request created" — ID EB-2026-0043. Assigned: VP Sales + Eng Lead.
Carmen (Customer Success): I'll join the bridge and handle onboarding items after signoff.
Liam (SalesOps): Preliminary pricing: Hosted w/ dedicated-egress add-on ≈ +12% list; Dedicated reserved ≈ +30% commit. I'll formalize numbers after Maya's runbook.
Priya (Security): Ari, send the CISO contact and the security questionnaire answers we have so far. I'll review and mark gaps.
Ari (AE): CISO is "ciso@cobaltbank.com"; procurement lead is "pm@cobaltbank.com". Sending questionnaire now.
Derek (Eng): Draft curl snippet:
``ncat --ssl "https://inference.redwood.example/v1/generate" -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' --cert client.crt --key client.key
```
Ari (AE): Thanks — can we get the runbook + pricing by 17:00 PT today? If not, escalate to exec bridge for 11:00 PT.
Maya (Eng-Infra): On it, will post PRD-style note in thread by 16:30 PT.
Nora (Legal): I'll prep the SOW clause draft and drop it in thread.
Priya (Security): I'll review PKI requirements and add comments.
Derek (Eng): FYI potential blocker: if their firewall terminates TLS with a proxy, mutual TLS may need proxy configuration — flagging as a dependency.
Ari (AE): Noted. Thanks everyone. I'll update CobaltBank after we post the runbook. :thumbsup:
